sub: The book site, the pre-order page, the endorsements and the bonuses already exist. What is missing is a checkout that takes the money, an offer after it, and the emails that carry a reader from the book to Joy's programs.

markers.text: Break-even: $52 benchmark AOV against an estimated $40 CPA. The ads are paid for before the first email goes out.

nodes.label: Meta Ads
nodes.job: Instagram and Facebook ads, pointed at the sales page. Her community and early-reader list are the seed for lookalikes and retargeting.

nodes.label: Becoming Magnificent Book Sales Page
nodes.job: Sales page on Bookfunnels. Her copy needs adjusting for conversion optimization; the checkout is new.

popup.title: Becoming Magnificent
body: Her book site already carries the pitch, the ten-point summary, the author story and three endorsements: Michael Strasner, Vicki Kennedy and Eugenie Kuzmina. All of it moves onto a Bookfunnels page built to sell.
Today the pre-order form collects a name, an address and an edition, then says "No payment will be collected at this time." The new page takes payment at the point of order and ships on release.
Three tiers: $21 ebook only, $29 audiobook bundle, $37 paperback bundle. The signed hardcover becomes the bump.
Captures email and shipping address. Paperbacks shipped by AccuTrack.

nodes.label: Order Form
nodes.price: $21 ebook only, $29 audiobook bundle, $37 paperback bundle
nodes.job: Three tiers. Card details captured here, for the first time.

nodes.label: Signed Collector Upgrade
nodes.job: Bump upgrade. One tick, above the order button.

popup.kicker: Bump upgrade, inside the order form
popup.title: The Signed Collector Edition
popup.check: YES! Upgrade my copy to the signed hardcover with a personal note from Joy for $24
body: The hardcover, signed, with a personal note from the author. It is the collector edition her site already offers at $48; as a bump it is the same upgrade for the $24 difference.
For the reader who wants the book as an object, not just a read.

nodes.label: Becoming Magnificent Companion Bundle
nodes.job: One-click offer. Her four existing bonuses, sold as the practices behind the book. No card re-entry.

popup.title: Becoming Magnificent Companion Bundle
body: The Exclusive Journal Companion, the Virtual Meditation Guide, the Digital Affirmations and the Reader's Reflection Guide.
Today all four are given away as pre-order bonuses. As a bundle they are the offer for the reader who wants the practices, not just the pages, and the offer that makes the ad spend back.
Nothing to create. Package and wire.

nodes.label: Order Confirmation
nodes.job: Confirms the order and points the buyer to the reader portal.

nodes.label: Secure Custom Reader Portal
nodes.job: Where the buyer logs in and downloads. The paperback ships; the rest is in here.

items.title: The digital edition her page already lists

items.title: The audiobook, for the $29 and $37 tiers

items.label: Bundle
items.title: The Becoming Magnificent Companion Bundle, for bundle buyers

nodes.label: Nurture Sequence
nodes.job: Twenty-one emails over thirty days, in Joy's voice. Delivers the book, builds the relationship, then opens the doors to her programs.

nodes.label: Becoming Magnificent Retreat
nodes.job: Listed on her site among her curated experiences. Sold in a conversation with Joy.

popup.title: Becoming Magnificent Retreat
body: Listed on her site among her curated experiences. The high door: an in-person experience of the book, sold in a conversation with Joy.
Every reader arriving here has bought the book, given an address, and read three weeks of Joy's emails.

nodes.label: Intelligent Beauty Method
nodes.job: Her signature method. The book is its front end; the program is the help.

popup.title: The Intelligent Beauty Method
body: Her signature method, in her words "a set of guidelines and principles combined with ancient practices and modern technologies." The book is its front end; the program is the help.
Sold in a conversation with Joy, to a reader who has already paid for the book twice.

nodes.label: Magnificent Collective
nodes.job: The private community, 2,343 members today. Sold straight from the emails and from the book itself.

popup.title: The Magnificent Collective
body: The private community, 2,343 members today, entered from her site. The low door, sold straight from the emails and from the book, to a reader who already feels part of the movement.
